module.purpose: Defines the router provider's location-matching options and strongly typed navigation and location-building contracts.
module.summary: This module contains shared TypeScript contracts for matching locations, committing navigation changes, navigating between route paths, and constructing parsed locations. It centralizes optional navigation behavior such as replacement, scroll handling, view transitions, blocker bypassing, and deprecated transition flags while preserving route-tree-aware generic typing.
module.businessContext: Supports client-side application routing and navigation behavior. Incorrect contracts could break route transitions, URL construction, scroll restoration, or type-safe navigation across the application.
classes: MatchLocation (~L6-11): Describes optional criteria for matching a router location
CommitLocationOptions (~L13-22): Configures navigation commit, scrolling, transitions, and blocker behavior
NavigateFn (~L24-32): Defines route-aware asynchronous navigation function parameters and result
BuildLocationFn (~L34-46): Defines typed parsed-location construction options and result
functions: NavigateFn (~L24-32): Performs typed navigation and resolves after navigation completes
BuildLocationFn (~L34-46): Builds a parsed location from typed route and mask options
systemCapabilities: Match locations using configurable route criteria
Build parsed locations from route options

edgeCases.behavior: Hash scrolling accepts either a boolean or ScrollIntoViewOptions.
The legacy startTransition option remains accepted but is explicitly marked deprecated.

edgeCases.behavior: Builder options permit leaveParams, validation inclusion, and navigation-mode flags.
